source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top parses
summary: Incinerate as the primary nuke with Immolate kept up (Incinerate bonus damage on an Immolated target) and Conflagrate on cooldown.

Shadow Bolt.note: a fire/Incinerate build should fill with Incinerate, not Shadow Bolt - check your build and action bars

advisory: Immolate must stay up - Incinerate does bonus damage to an Immolated target, so a dropped Immolate is a direct DPS loss. Fight notes: on movement-heavy fights (Vashj phase transitions, Kael adds, Lady Vashj's striders) refresh Immolate before repositioning so the Incinerate bonus does not fall off; on add-heavy pulls (Hydross adds, Karathress) Conflagrate consumes Immolate, so weigh holding it for single-target burst versus tagging the priority target. Keep Curse of the Elements on the boss for the raid-wide fire/shadow amp.
